shots.text: At Sylvanmere we cut Elowen out of the Elder Broodmother, the rotten thing that had grown over her inside the oldest tree. She was very old, and very tired.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Broodmother collapsing; grey bark peeling away to reveal Elowen, bent, with white-blossom hair.

shots.text: The tree is dying. It has one seed left. Take it, child, and plant it somewhere the dark can't reach.
shots.speaker: elowen
shots.art_note: Elowen pressing a single glowing seed into Sylvaine's hand.

shots.text: The Hollow drew back out of the forest. Three lands were free, and we went home to Solenne for one night's rest.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Grey mist pulling back from the roots; the glow-moss lighting again. The army on the road west, Sylvaine's closed hand glowing green.
